$keys := SELECT storage.storage_objects {
    entry := coalesce(case(strpos(substr(key, length($prefix) + 1), $delimiter) > 0, left(key, length($prefix) + strpos(substr(key, length($prefix) + 1), $delimiter) + length($delimiter) - 1), key), key),

  TAKE $limit

body.query: SELECT org.departments { _id, code, name } FILTER active SORT name
SELECT org.product_teams { _id, code, name } FILTER active SORT name
SELECT org.locations { _id, name, country, legalEntity := legalEntity._id } FILTER active SORT name
SELECT org.legal_entities { _id, code, name, country } SORT name
SELECT org.cost_centers { _id, code, name } FILTER active SORT code

SELECT EFFECTIVE $asOf org.departments { _id, code, name, active, head := head.person.name, headId := head._id,
  teamId := team._id, parentTeamId := team.parent._id, parentTeam := team.parent.name,
  members := team.memberships[count(*)],
  nameHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL name { value, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo } SORT -_effectiveFrom),
  headHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL head { value := value.person.name, reason, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo } SORT -_effectiveFrom),
  activeHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL active { value, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo } SORT -_effectiveFrom)
} SORT code

SELECT EFFECTIVE $asOf org.product_teams { _id, code, name, active, head := head.person.name, headId := head._id,
  nameHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL name { value, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo } SORT -_effectiveFrom),
  headHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL head { value := value.person.name, reason, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo } SORT -_effectiveFrom),
  activeHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL active { value, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo } SORT -_effectiveFrom)
} SORT code
INSERT EFFECTIVE $from org.product_teams { code: $code, name: $name, active: true } -> { _id, code }
UPDATE EFFECTIVE $from org.product_teams [_id == $id::uuid] { name: $name } -> { _id }
UPDATE EFFECTIVE $from org.departments [_id == $id::uuid] { active: $active::boolean } -> { _id }
UPDATE EFFECTIVE $from org.product_teams [_id == $id::uuid] { active: $active::boolean } -> { _id }

ASSERT length(trim(coalesce($reason::text, ''))) > 0 code: 'missing_reason', message: 'A reason is required.', status: 422;
UPDATE EFFECTIVE $from org.departments [_id == $id::uuid] { head: $head, head.reason: $reason } -> { _id }

ASSERT length(trim(coalesce($reason::text, ''))) > 0 code: 'missing_reason', message: 'A reason is required.', status: 422;
UPDATE EFFECTIVE $from org.product_teams [_id == $id::uuid] { head: $head, head.reason: $reason } -> { _id }

SELECT org.locations { _id, name, country, timezone, active, legalEntity := legalEntity._id, legalEntityName := legalEntity.name, payCalendar := payCalendar._id, payCalendarName := payCalendar.name } SORT name
UPSERT org.locations [_id == $id::uuid] { name: $name, country: $country, timezone: $timezone, legalEntity: $legalEntity, payCalendar: $payCalendar, active: $active } -> { _id, name }
SELECT org.cost_centers { _id, code, name, active } SORT code
UPSERT org.cost_centers [_id == $id::uuid] { code: $code, name: $name, active: $active } -> { _id, code }

ASSERT $effectiveDate::date IS NOT NULL code: 'missing_date', message: 'An effective date is required.', status: 422;
UPDATE EFFECTIVE $effectiveDate core.employees [_id == $employee] { ...$changes } -> { _id }

ASSERT length(trim(coalesce($reason::text, ''))) > 0 code: 'missing_reason', message: 'A reason is required.', status: 422;
UPDATE EFFECTIVE $effectiveDate core.employees [_id == $employee] { status: CASE($onLeave::boolean, 'leave', 'active'), status.reason: $reason } -> { _id }
UPDATE EFFECTIVE $atDate core.employees [_id == $employee] { jobTitle: UPDATE { value: $value, reason: $reason } } -> { _id }

SELECT core.employees {
  _id, userId := person._id, employeeNumber, name := person.name, preferredName := person.nickname, picture := person.picture,
  jobTitle, department := department.name, departmentId := department._id, productTeam := productTeam.name,
  location := location.name, locationId := location._id, manager := manager.person.name, managerId := manager._id, status,
  workEmail := @value (SELECT FIRST person.emails { email } FILTER primary == true), hireDate
} FILTER NOT guest() AND status != 'terminated'
  AND ($department::uuid IS NULL OR department._id == $department::uuid)
  AND ($location::uuid IS NULL OR location._id == $location::uuid)
  AND ($status::text IS NULL OR status == $status::text)
  SORT name

SELECT core.employees { _id, employeeNumber, name := person.name, hireDate,
  statusHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL status { value, reason, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo, recordedBy := _createdBy.name, recordedAt := _createdAt } SORT -_effectiveFrom),
  jobTitleHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL jobTitle { value, reason, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo, recordedBy := _createdBy.name, recordedAt := _createdAt } SORT -_effectiveFrom),
  departmentHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL department { value := value.name, reason, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo, recordedBy := _createdBy.name, recordedAt := _createdAt } SORT -_effectiveFrom),
  productTeamHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL productTeam { value := value.name, reason, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo, recordedBy := _createdBy.name, recordedAt := _createdAt } SORT -_effectiveFrom),
  managerHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL manager { value := value.person.name, reason, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo, recordedBy := _createdBy.name, recordedAt := _createdAt } SORT -_effectiveFrom),
  locationHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL location { value := value.name, reason, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo, recordedBy := _createdBy.name, recordedAt := _createdAt } SORT -_effectiveFrom),
  legalEntityHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL legalEntity { value := value.name, reason, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo, recordedBy := _createdBy.name, recordedAt := _createdAt } SORT -_effectiveFrom),
  costCenterHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL costCenter { value := value.name, reason, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo, recordedBy := _createdBy.name, recordedAt := _createdAt } SORT -_effectiveFrom),
  employmentTypeHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL employmentType { value, reason, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo, recordedBy := _createdBy.name, recordedAt := _createdAt } SORT -_effectiveFrom),
  workScheduleHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL workSchedule { value, reason, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo, recordedBy := _createdBy.name, recordedAt := _createdAt } SORT -_effectiveFrom),
  fteHistory := (SELECT EFFECTIVE ALL fte { value, reason, _effectiveFrom, _effectiveTo, recordedBy := _createdBy.name, recordedAt := _createdAt } SORT -_effectiveFrom)
} FILTER _id == $employee

SELECT EFFECTIVE $asOf core.employees { _id, name := person.name, jobTitle, department := department.name, productTeam := productTeam.name, managerId := manager._id, manager := manager.person.name, status } FILTER status IS NOT NULL AND status != 'terminated' SORT name

SELECT core.employees { _id, employeeNumber, name := person.name, preferredName := person.nickname, jobTitle, department := department.name, location := location.name, manager := manager.person.name, status, hireDate, isHrAdmin := 'hr_admin' IN $context.role, isHrManager := 'hr_manager' IN $context.role, isManager := core.employees HAS (manager.person._id == $context.userId), canDelegate := 'manager' IN $context.role } FILTER person == $context.userId

SELECT core.employees { _id, name := person.name, preferredName := person.nickname, jobTitle, location := location.name, status, hireDate }
  FILTER manager.person == $context.userId AND status != 'terminated' SORT name

$p := SELECT pto.pay_periods { _id, periodStart, periodEnd, cal := calendar._id, yearStart := date_trunc('year', periodStart)::date } FILTER _id == $period TAKE 1;
SELECT EFFECTIVE $p.periodEnd pto.policy_assignments {
  employee := employee._id, employeeNumber := employee.employeeNumber, employeeName := employee.person.name,
  policy := policy._id, policyName := policy.name, payPeriod := $p._id, entryDate := $p.periodEnd,
  status := employee.status, fte := employee.fte,
  alreadyPosted := employee.ptoLedger HAS (policy == $row.policy AND payPeriod._id == $period AND entryType == $choice(accrual)),
  ytdAccrued := coalesce(employee.ptoLedger[sum(hours) FILTER policy == $row.policy AND entryType == $choice(accrual) AND entryDate >= $p.yearStart AND entryDate < $p.periodStart], 0),
  hours := round(least(
      policy.accrualHoursPerPeriod
        * CASE(policy.prorateByFte, coalesce(employee.fte, 1), 1)
        * CASE(policy.prorateFirstPeriod AND employee.hireDate > $p.periodStart,
               ($p.periodEnd - employee.hireDate + 1)::decimal / ($p.periodEnd - $p.periodStart + 1), 1),
      CASE(policy.annualAccrualCapHours IS NULL, 999999,
           greatest(policy.annualAccrualCapHours - coalesce(employee.ptoLedger[sum(hours) FILTER policy == $row.policy AND entryType == $choice(accrual) AND entryDate >= $p.yearStart AND entryDate < $p.periodStart], 0), 0))
    ), 4)
} FILTER employee.location.payCalendar IN $p.cal
    AND employee.hireDate <= $p.periodEnd
    AND (employee.status == 'active' OR (employee.status == 'leave' AND policy.accrueDuringLeave))
  SORT employeeNumber, policyName

INSERT pto.ledger EACH $entries { employee: $item.employee, policy: $item.policy, payPeriod: $item.payPeriod, entryType: $choice($item.entryType), hours: $item.hours, entryDate: $item.entryDate, reason: $item.reason }
  ON CONFLICT (employee, policy, payPeriod, entryType) DO NOTHING -> { _id, employee, hours }

SELECT pto.policy_assignments {
  employee := employee._id, employeeNumber := employee.employeeNumber, employeeName := employee.person.name,
  department := employee.department.name, location := employee.location.name, status := employee.status,
  policy := policy._id, policyName := policy.name, ptoType := policy.ptoType.name, paid := policy.ptoType.paid, onTermination := policy.onTermination,
  accrued := coalesce(employee.ptoLedger[sum(hours) FILTER policy == $row.policy AND (entryType == $choice(accrual) OR entryType == $choice(carryover))], 0),
  used := coalesce(employee.ptoLedger[sum(hours) FILTER policy == $row.policy AND entryType == $choice(usage)], 0) * -1,
  adjusted := coalesce(employee.ptoLedger[sum(hours) FILTER policy == $row.policy AND (entryType == $choice(adjustment) OR entryType == $choice(recalculation) OR entryType == $choice(expiry) OR entryType == $choice(payout))], 0),
  remaining := coalesce(employee.ptoLedger[sum(hours) FILTER policy == $row.policy], 0),
  closingHours := coalesce(employee.ptoLedger[sum(hours) FILTER policy == $row.policy], 0) * -1,
  pending := coalesce(employee.ptoRequests[sum(hours) FILTER policy == $row.policy AND status == 'pending'], 0),
  projected := coalesce(employee.ptoLedger[sum(hours) FILTER policy == $row.policy], 0) - coalesce(employee.ptoRequests[sum(hours) FILTER policy == $row.policy AND status == 'pending'], 0)
} FILTER ($employee::uuid IS NULL OR employee._id == $employee::uuid)
  SORT employeeNumber, policyName

SELECT pto.holidays { country, name, hours, newDate := make_date($toYear::int, date_part('month', holidayDate)::int, date_part('day', holidayDate)::int), newYear := $toYear::int }
  FILTER country == $country AND calendarYear == $fromYear::int SORT holidayDate

INSERT pto.holidays EACH $holidays { country: $item.country, holidayDate: $item.holidayDate, calendarYear: $item.calendarYear, name: $item.name, hours: $item.hours }
  ON CONFLICT (country, holidayDate) DO NOTHING -> { _id, holidayDate, name }

SELECT pto.ledger { _id, entryDate, hours, reason, entryType, employeeNumber := employee.employeeNumber, employeeName := employee.person.name, department := employee.department.name, location := employee.location.name, status := employee.status, policy := policy.name, ptoType := policy.ptoType.name }
  FILTER entryType == $choice(usage) AND entryDate >= $from::date AND entryDate <= $to::date
    AND ($department::uuid IS NULL OR employee.department._id == $department::uuid)
    AND ($location::uuid IS NULL OR employee.location._id == $location::uuid)
    AND ($status::text IS NULL OR employee.status == $status::text)
  SORT -entryDate

SELECT pto.policy_assignments {
  employee := employee._id, employeeNumber := employee.employeeNumber, employeeName := employee.person.name,
  policy := policy._id, policyName := policy.name, maxCarryover := policy.maxCarryoverHours,
  payPeriod := @value (SELECT FIRST employee.location.payCalendar.periods { _id } FILTER periodStart == make_date($year::int, 12, 1)),
  entryDate := make_date($year::int, 12, 31),
  balanceAtYearEnd := coalesce(employee.ptoLedger[sum(hours) FILTER policy == $row.policy AND entryDate <= make_date($year::int, 12, 31)], 0),
  hours := least(0, coalesce(policy.maxCarryoverHours, 999999) - coalesce(employee.ptoLedger[sum(hours) FILTER policy == $row.policy AND entryDate <= make_date($year::int, 12, 31)], 0)),
  alreadyPosted := employee.ptoLedger HAS (policy == $row.policy AND entryType == $choice(expiry) AND entryDate == make_date($year::int, 12, 31))
} FILTER employee.hireDate <= make_date($year::int, 12, 31)
  SORT employeeNumber, policyName

SELECT pto.requests { _id, startDate, endDate, hours, partialDay, note, status, policy := policy.name, ptoType := policy.ptoType.name, decidedBy := decidedBy.name, decisionNote, _createdAt } FILTER employee.person == $context.userId SORT -startDate
UPDATE pto.requests [_id == $id AND employee.person == $context.userId AND status == 'pending'] { status: 'canceled' } -> { _id, status }

SELECT pto.policies { _id, name, country, ptoType := ptoType._id, ptoTypeName := ptoType.name, employmentType, accrualHoursPerPeriod, prorateByFte, prorateFirstPeriod, annualAccrualCapHours, maxCarryoverHours, carryoverExpiryMonths, minRequestHours, accrueDuringLeave, onTermination, active, assigned := assignments[count(*)] } SORT country, name
SELECT pto.pto_types { _id, code, name, category, paid, active } SORT name
UPSERT pto.pto_types [_id == $id::uuid] { code: $code, name: $name, category: $choice($category), paid: $paid, active: $active } -> { _id, name }
SELECT pto.holidays { _id, country, holidayDate, calendarYear, name, hours, status } FILTER country == $country AND calendarYear == $year::int SORT holidayDate
INSERT pto.holidays { country: $country, holidayDate: $holidayDate, calendarYear: date_part('year', $holidayDate::date)::int, name: $name, hours: $hours } -> { _id }
UPDATE pto.holidays [_id == $id::uuid] { status: $status } -> { _id, status }
DELETE pto.holidays [_id == $id::uuid AND status == 'draft'] -> { _id }

ASSERT length(trim(coalesce($reason::text, ''))) > 0 code: 'missing_reason', message: 'An adjustment needs a reason.', status: 422;
INSERT pto.ledger { employee: $employee, policy: $policy, entryType: $choice(adjustment), hours: $hours, entryDate: current_date, reason: $reason } -> { _id }

ASSERT 'hr_admin' IN $context.role OR 'hr_manager' IN $context.role code: 'forbidden', message: 'HR only.', status: 403;
SELECT pto.pay_periods { _id, calendar := calendar.name, country := calendar.country, periodStart, periodEnd, payDate, closed := periodEnd < current_date, posted := pto.ledger HAS (payPeriod._id == $row._id AND entryType == $choice(accrual)) } SORT -periodStart
UPDATE pto.policies [_id == $id::uuid] { employmentType: $choice($employmentType) } -> { _id }
UPDATE pto.policies [_id == $id::uuid] { employmentType: null } -> { _id }
SELECT pto.pay_calendars { _id, name, country } SORT name
INSERT audit.export_log { actor: $context.userId, reportName: $reportName, format: $choice($format), filters: $filters, rowCount: $rowCount, generatedAt: now() } -> { _id, generatedAt }
